Subject: FinTrust audit prereqs + question catalog

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking our intake call yesterday. We’re pulling together the formal questionnaire set for our scoped SIG+SOC2 deep-dive next month. Before we circulate the packet to our auditors, a couple of quick clarifying asks so we can avoid rework: 

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood maintains continuous KMS rotation logs for customer encryption keys or if you provide snapshot extracts for audit? If extracts, what exact window (UTC) do you typically provide?
2) For CAIQ control narratives, do you have one consolidated sysdesc (system description) PDF we can reference, or should we assemble per-service artifacts?
3) Any known control exceptions or temporary compensating controls in the last 12 months we should treat as pre-acknowledged?

If you can send a short answer catalog and any sample artifacts by Oct 12 it would help our scheduling. We’ll attach the auditor-facing questionnaire after the catalog is confirmed.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Director, Third-Party Risk
FinTrust Bank

--

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: FinTrust audit prereqs + question catalog

Hi Samir — thanks, and good to meet yesterday. High level answers inline below; attaching a short sysdesc and a sample KMS excerpt for quick review.

1) KMS rotation: Redwood rotates platform keys on a scheduled cadence and retains rotation metadata centrally. For customer-managed keys in HSM/KMS we provide snapshot extracts for the requested audit window (UTC timestamps). Typical extraction window is a 48-hour slice around requested snapshot time; if you need continuous streaming logs we can provide a near-real-time export but it requires a brief intake with our infra team. (See attached: kms_rotation_log_excerpt.csv)

2) CAIQ/sysdesc: We maintain a consolidated system description (soc2-sysdesc-2026-09.pdf) that covers hosting modes (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) plus control boundaries; auditors often accept that plus per-service supplements. I’ve attached the consolidated sysdesc.

3) Exceptions: There are two documented temporary workarounds from Q1 2026 listed in our change log; both had compensating controls and remediation completed. I’ll loop in Kimberly and Rishi to map owners and confirm which artifacts auditors typically expect.

Next steps: I’ll coordinate owners and put together a compact answer catalog for the three items above and the CAIQ/SIG set by EOD Oct 12. If you have a preferred file format for the catalog (spreadsheet vs doc), let me know.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: soc2-sysdesc-2026-09.pdf (system description), kms_rotation_log_excerpt.csv (sample extract)

Thanks Kim — confirmed. A couple of clarifications before we hand to FinTrust: 

- KMS extracts: our export includes key id, rotation timestamp, and operator id fields. We can redact operator IDs if requested, but auditors usually need them. Will the FinTrust auditors accept a redacted extract plus a notarized explanation?
- Snapshot windows: we can provide a guaranteed UTC snapshot at a requested timestamp; the 48-hour slice Kim mentioned is our default for context. If they want continuous streaming logs we’ll need an intake ticket and a 2-week lead time.

I’ll prepare the export example and a short note on redaction policy; Olga, please flag if the FinTrust NDA needs amendment for operator-level PII.

-Rishi

Subject: Re: FinTrust audit prereqs + question catalog (catalog attached)

Samir — attached is the compact question catalog and three sample artifacts we discussed: a consolidated system description, a KMS rotation excerpt, and our S3 snapshot extraction instructions. High-level answers: 

- KMS rotation: Redwood provides snapshot extracts for customer-managed keys; standard turnaround for a one-off snapshot is 3 business days. Extract format: CSV with key_id, rotation_ts_utc, algorithm, and operator_id. If you require operator_id redaction, indicate "redact=true" and we’ll provide a redacted extract plus a notarized statement explaining the redaction.
- System description: use the attached consolidated sysdesc as the authoritative doc. We also have per-service supplements if auditors request deeper traceability.
- Exceptions: the two temporary Q1-2026 mitigations are documented and included in the catalog (see row 8–9). All remediations were completed and validated by QA.

Attachments included: soc2-sysdesc-2026-09.pdf; kms_rotation_log_excerpt.csv; redwood_s3_snapshot_instructions.pdf

If this aligns, we can accept the auditor questionnaire and map each auditor question to the corresponding artifact and owner. Happy to hop on a 20-minute sync if the audit team prefers live clarification.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
